minimality_note: Counting, peeling and contribution-specific helper implementations are excised. In butterfly_utils.h only CountSpace and the bipartite/ranked wedge-generation, hash insertion, batch-boundary and retrieval block is replaced with nonfunctional API stubs for the preserved private baseline; all surrounding graph/loading/ranking code is unchanged. The private reference restores six of the seven affected headers exactly to upstream; in butterfly_count_total.h it restores upstream and changes only CountTotal's ranking dispatch for BATCHS, which applies the paper's Section 6.2.2 f-metric rule (side ordering when degree ordering would not reduce the processed wedges by at least 10%, degree ordering otherwise) instead of always computing the requested ranking.
